authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The near forelimb runs from roughly (65,85) to (80,123), nearly the length of the upright neck, and ends in a broad flat boot. Redraw a shorter connected shoulder/elbow/wrist chain with a compact hooked forepaw nearer the torso; separate two or three tapered claw tips instead of lining a rectangular sole with gold dots. Preserve coil contact at y=124 and carry the same limb proportions through idle_b/idle_c, windup, move, attack, recover, hit and the extra states.

The rear horn is a long straight diagonal spike, while the far horn near (73,19) reads mostly as an upright stub. Reshape both into smaller tapering clusters with a visible backward bend toward the left; preserve distinct near/far horn roots and the same horn anatomy in the remaining poses.

The relaxed far forepaw projects right as a smooth pale paddle with no readable wrist or claw separation. Add a small wrist bend and distinct hooked distal claw pixels while keeping its shoulder connection continuous; repeat the anatomical correction in sleep_b. Check the raised paw near (80,79) in poison_a/poison_b, where the similarly broad rounded endpoint obscures the clawed-hand shape.
